description: A link that opens the structure in the Hydroxyl editor as a new, unsaved sketch. The structure travels in the URL fragment, which the browser does not send to the server.

molfile.description: An MDL molfile (V2000 or V3000), the whole text including the header lines.

name.description: A common name from the editor's structure dictionary, e.g. "benzene", "glycine", "DMSO". Not a full name-to-structure parser: unknown names are refused.

name: editor_link
title: Link to the structure in the editor
